Popatlal accidentally bumps into Champaklal, knocking his walking stick to the ground. Champaklal angrily scolds Popatlal to pick up the stick, but Sodhi misinterprets the order and suddenly scoops Bapuji up into his arms instead, leading to a hilarious mix-up before Bapuji heads upstairs.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
